The '''AA/SL proton torpedo launcher''' was a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]]. [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was equipped with two such launchers, each of which held three [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
